    "6059a981: ;If X is ' ' (space) and the data element allows DEFAULT response codes, get the default value from the NEW PERSON file.",

    "4a8b7652: ;Loop through ';' pieces of DU looking for a match with X. If a match is found and there is an executable DIC('S') code, execute it.",

    "eaf8f9e1: ;Validate numeric input with decimal points.",
    "a23b425b: ;Execute the code embedded in 'X' cross-reference of this input variable.",
    "fa9fa75d: ;If X was entered, save it in ^UTILITY($J), possibly deleting previous value for this input variable depending on DV parameter.",
    "14eee525: ;If DB(DQ) is defined, we had been editing this field, now reset it.",
    "4d43d09f: ;Set X to ?BAD if it failed everything.",
    "d9c91de2: ;If X is '?', execute QQ^DIEQ to handle questions, then go to 'B' label.",
    "9c54829b: ;Set field, dictionary, file, level, variable flags, data, question",
    "ef6cb3b3: ;If no entry call output transform; if value is '@' go to reader; if not a required entry and value is '@' quit",
    "318447a7: ;Get current value from dictionary; if defined, execute code",
    "59ecf076: ;If pointer, get piece #2 from pointer global; if value defined, get piece #1",
    "0d00035f: ;If variable, get piece #1 from variable pointer global; if DD, get piece #2, #3",
    "54ed1ebb: ;If set or word processing field, do set-up special-dictionary logic",
    "d8c5ea55: ;If output transform used and value not present, go to reader; else quit",
    "0a0f303f: ;If not input transform or MUMPS xecute code, go to reader",
    "cac2b9b3: ;Do input transform and code execute code",
    "47185e76: ;Done",
    "b8643432: ;Name of routine, initial question number",
    "0250187c: ;Executable help code, field dictionary, file and level; required 'P' for pointer field",
    "4d64599e: ;Pointer to file 200",
    "ba24a54c: ;Get value of DGJT1PH",
    "8323f27d: ;Save value to Y",
    "0c12c32c: If the pointer data is null, branch to null input logic",
    "64b6dee5: If the data is present, validate and store it. Otherwise read new data.",
    "717d9da4: Returns to calling routine",
    "498f8aa2: Jumps to next routine DGJXA7"
  ]
}
